purpose: Repair research cohort semantics without changing Formal selection, while reusing PVE-156 for complete qualified-pool integrity.
invariants: Formal scoreCandidate order and outputs unchanged
No future outcomes in selection-time receipts
Historical rows are never silently rewritten

poolIntegrity.role: Immutable complete per-pool ordered qualified list and exact cutline evidence.

populationReceipt.semantics: Immutable denominator / sampling-frame receipt; insert-once, duplicate fingerprint must match or conflict.

membershipOverlay.semantics: One symbol can carry multiple research memberships without replacing its Formal-state identity.
rules: Formal-state membership and control membership may overlap.
INDEPENDENT_BROAD_MARKET_CONTROL is sampled from a frozen frame before focal cohort sample caps.
RESIDUAL_CONTROL, if used, is mutually exclusive by full semantic classification and is a different estimand.
Never use `used` from prior bounded samples to define the independent broad-market frame.
A membership row is not a trade signal and cannot alter monitoring.

qualityOverlay.role: Append-only later QA findings for immutable historical memberships/snapshots.
rules: Never UPDATE historical evidence to hide original capture.
Later-discovered quality information is an append-only annotation.
Outcome reports must filter/report quality overlays explicitly.

formalStateContract.firstFailureMeaning: First observed failing gate under the exact scan-date Formal gate order; not marginal gate effect.
formalStateContract.gateOverlapObserver: Separate PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUABLE research overlay; never substitute for Formal state.

independentBroadMarket.samplingFrame: Frozen eligible frame defined before focal cohort sample truncation.
independentBroadMarket.use: Selection Alpha against a broad baseline.

residual.samplingFrame: Explicit rows outside all preregistered focal semantic populations.

nearMissRepair.sampling: Stratify by pool × nearestChannel × failed-check-pattern before deterministic hash; no outcome-based distance score.

rejectionRepair.currentProblem: Old generic REJECTED_AFTER_BASE reason starvation and first-failure attribution.
rules: Name counts `firstFailureCount`, never marginal gate contribution.
Use gate-overlap observer for overlap; never subtract first-fail count from zero-pick as counterfactual.

historicalMigration.approach: Versioned membership/quality overlay only where state can be proven from immutable PIT snapshot; otherwise UNKNOWN.
historicalMigration.preV813Comparator: Exact current-comparator replay is UNKNOWN where priority/consensus provenance was not frozen.
historicalMigration.currentArchiveMutability: Existing trade_research_shadow_candidates may be rewritten by scan_date; do not call it immutable first-known truth.

acceptanceTests: Changing focal cohort sample cap cannot change INDEPENDENT_BROAD_MARKET_CONTROL membership for a frozen frame/date/seed.
Same symbol can have primary Formal-state membership plus independent broad-control membership.
Reason A abundance cannot starve Reason B sample.
firstFailureCount changes under synthetic gate-order swap while all-fail overlap stays invariant; report semantics must distinguish them.
Near-miss A/B pool/channel strata cannot be starved by an earlier global top-N.
Duplicate immutable receipt with same fingerprint is idempotent; different payload/fingerprint is conflict, never overwrite.
Formal frozen fixture selected symbols/order/plans/capital/signals are byte-equivalent before/after research capture.

governance.reason: Additive D1 schema and membership read/write paths touch shared Production storage/runtime even though decisionImpact=false.
governance.versionLineGuard: Do not implement while V8.15 PR #112 and current draft research branches are unresolved without explicit lineage reconciliation.

optimizationRelevance.role: Evidence-quality prerequisite. It may invalidate/strengthen later Selection Alpha and gate-relaxation findings but is not itself an alpha improvement.
